```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
```

## create within/across dataset
```{r}
# 设定数据目录
data_dir <- "../data/monthly/"

# 生成 2020-2022 年所有月份的文件名
years <- 2020:2022
months <- sprintf("%02d", 1:12)  # 01, 02, ..., 12
file_dates <- as.vector(outer(years, months, paste0))  # 202001, 202002, ..., 202212
file_list <- paste0(data_dir, "network_", file_dates, ".csv")  # 完整文件路径

# 读取节点信息
nodes <- read.csv("../data/Seoul_node_info.csv")
node_to_gu <- setNames(nodes$gu, nodes$node)

# 初始化结果列表
within_density_list <- list()
across_density_list <- list()

# 处理每个文件
for (i in seq_along(file_list)) {
  file_path <- file_list[i]
  file_date <- file_dates[i]  # 提取日期，例如 "202001"

  if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
    message("File not found: ", file_path)
    next  # 跳过缺失的文件
  }
  
  # 读取网络数据
  network_data <- read.csv(file_path)
  
  # 添加 gu 信息
  network_data$source_gu <- node_to_gu[as.character(network_data$source)]
  network_data$target_gu <- node_to_gu[as.character(network_data$target)]
  
  # 计算 within_density
  within_density <- network_data %>%
    filter(source_gu == target_gu) %>%
    group_by(source_gu) %>%
    summarise(value = sum(strength, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    rename(gu = source_gu) %>%
    mutate(date = file_date)
  
  # 计算 across_density
  across_density <- network_data %>%
    filter(source_gu != target_gu) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(source_gu, target_gu), values_to = "gu") %>%
    group_by(gu) %>%
    summarise(value = sum(strength, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    mutate(date = file_date)
  
  # 存储到列表
  within_density_list[[file_date]] <- within_density
  across_density_list[[file_date]] <- across_density
}

# 合并所有时间点的数据
within_density_df <- bind_rows(within_density_list) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = date, values_from = value, values_fill = 0) %>%
  arrange(gu)

across_density_df <- bind_rows(across_density_list) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = date, values_from = value, values_fill = 0) %>%
  arrange(gu)

# 提取列名并排序
correct_order <- c("gu", sort(setdiff(colnames(within_density_df), "gu")))

# 重新排列列名
within_density_df <- within_density_df[, correct_order]
across_density_df <- across_density_df[, correct_order]

# 保存结果
#write.csv(within_density_df, "../data/within_density.csv", row.names = FALSE)
#write.csv(across_density_df, "../data/across_density.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# 转换数据格式（从宽格式转为长格式）
within_density_long <- within_density_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -gu, names_to = "date", values_to = "within_density")

across_density_long <- across_density_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -gu, names_to = "date", values_to = "across_density")

# 转换日期格式为 Year-Month（YYYY-MM）
within_density_long$date <- format(as.Date(paste0(within_density_long$date, "01"), format="%Y%m%d"), "%Y-%m")
across_density_long$date <- format(as.Date(paste0(across_density_long$date, "01"), format="%Y%m%d"), "%Y-%m")

# 确保 date 是 factor，按照时间顺序排序
within_density_long$date <- factor(within_density_long$date, levels = unique(within_density_long$date))
across_density_long$date <- factor(across_density_long$date, levels = unique(across_density_long$date))

# 添加标签
within_density_long$variable <- "Within"
across_density_long$variable <- "Across"

# 统一除以1000000，单位变为百万
within_density_long <- within_density_long %>% mutate(density = within_density / 1e6)
across_density_long <- across_density_long %>% mutate(density = across_density / 1e6)

# 合并数据
density_data <- bind_rows(within_density_long, across_density_long)

density_data$variable <- factor(density_data$variable, levels = c("Within", "Across"))

# 绘图
WA_25gu <- ggplot(density_data, aes(x = date, y = density, color = gu, group = gu)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(. ~ variable, scales = "fixed") +  # 横向 facet，按 levels 控制顺序
  labs(x = "Year-Month", y = "Density (in million)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),  # 白色背景
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey80"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey80"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),  # 日期旋转90°
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16)
  )
ggsave("../result/Figure S1. WA_25gu.png", WA_25gu, width = 15, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

```
